pull_request.title: fix(agent): apply a Kind.LINE probe only to the methods it selects
pull_request.body: ## What does this change do? A `Kind.LINE` probe fired on the lines of **every** method of a matching class, ignoring `@OnMethod(method = ...)`. A probe with `method = "screen", line = -1` on `FraudScreen` also reported lines of `deepScore`. `Instrumentor.visitMethod` (ASM backend) let LINE probes bypass method matching; the ClassFile API backend already filtered by method (`ClassFileApiBackend.filterForMethod`), so the two backends disagreed. LINE probes now go through the same name, regex, `#` and type matching as every other kind. An empty `method` (the annotation default) still covers every method, so `samples/AllLines.java`, which sets no `method`, behaves as before. The `AllLines` *test* probe named `` while its tests expect every method to be instrumented; it now leaves `method` empty, so its golden data is unchanged. `Kind.LINE` and `Location.line` javadoc and QuickReference describe the behaviour. ## Related issue N/A (internal demo-bug backlog) ## Scope and compatibility - [x] I identified the affected module(s) and kept unrelated changes out of this PR. - [x] This preserves the supported Java/runtime compatibility tiers, or the change is documented below. - [x] This does not change the masked-JAR layout, class-loader boundary, or wire protocol. - [ ] If it does, I updated the relevant architecture documentation and verification plan. **Compatibility or migration notes:** **behaviour change.** A LINE probe that names a method now instruments only that method's lines. A script that named one method but relied on covering the whole class must leave `method` empty. This also applies to lines inside a lambda body (compiled into `lambda$$`) and to field initializers (``/``): a probe naming only the enclosing method no longer fires on them, silently. Select those methods too (e.g. `method = "/process|lambda\\$process\\$\\d+/"`) or leave `method` empty. Existing compiled probes, including migrated 2.x packs, are affected the same way. ## Testing - [x] Unit tests - [ ] Integration tests (if applicable) - [x] `spotlessCheck` - [x] Documentation/link or sample verification (if applicable) **Commands and results:** ```text ./gradlew :btrace-agent:test --tests '*LineInstrumentationTest' new probeOnEveryLineOfOneMethodLeavesTheOtherMethodsAlone: before → FAILED; after → passed ./gradlew :btrace-agent:test --tests '*OnMethodInstrumenterTest' -PupdateTestData → one new golden file (dynamic/onmethod/LineInMethod); no existing golden file changed (AllLines, Line, leveled/Line included) ./gradlew :btrace-agent:test → 970 tests, 0 failures, 123 skipped ./gradlew :btrace-core:test → 333 tests, 0 failures ./gradlew spotlessCheck → BUILD SUCCESSFUL ``` Not verified locally: `classFileApiBackendTest` (no JDK 28 toolchain here; that backend's code is unchanged). CI's JDK 28-ea job runs it. ## Documentation and release impact - [x] User-facing documentation is updated, or no documentation change is needed. - [ ] Release notes/changelog are updated, or no release-note entry is needed. - [x] Samples, distribution contents, or published coordinates are updated if affected. - [x] This change is safe to merge independently of a release, or the dependency is explained below. **Release notes / follow-up work:** needs a release-note line for the behaviour change above (not added here). ## Final checklist - [x] I reviewed the complete diff and removed unrelated changes. - [x] New or changed behavior has appropriate tests, or the reason for not adding them is explained above. - [x] User-facing behavior, APIs, samples, and documentation are consistent with this change. - [x] I did not include generated build output, local configuration, credentials, or other accidental files. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) - - - This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/btraceio/btrace/994)
